items.title: 3 US Agriculture Stocks Investors Are Watching After China Tariff Cuts
items.summary: When Washington and Beijing agree to trim tariffs on US$30b of goods each way, the story is not just about diplomacy; it is about containers of grain, soybeans and meat that suddenly face fewer hurdles on the way to Chinese ports. Investors who ignore that shift risk missing how it might reshape earnings power across US agricultural exporters.
